items: When ops, marketing and CX each work from separate dashboards, issues reach HQ late, campaigns ignore frontline feedback and nobody clearly owns the follow-up.
An AI customer experience platform can combine reviews, surveys, case logs and operational signals into a single source of truth that every team reads in plain language.
Route each piece of feedback by function, urgency or location so the right person gets the task, and track outcomes until the loop is closed.
You can start with one platform that integrates your review, survey and support tools; Momos was built for this kind of cross-team alignment across locations.
